messages.content:
Brief from the lead:
Pull these from the record, quoting exact values: fare type (refundable or nonrefundable); itinerary (domestic or international); event type; whether the traveler claims a medical or bereavement reason; hours since booking; days between booking and departure; and whether the carrier changed or canceled the flight, with any schedule-change minutes. Report any missing item as missing.

Record:
task E27-24
fare: nonrefundable
itinerary: domestic
event: voluntary-cancel
hours since booking: 200
booking was made this many days before departure: 60

State only the facts the brief asks for. At most 80 words.
